text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Red Desire...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction Red Desire pointed, I saw a claw machine filled with plushies styled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Looks like a new one just came out. Want it?
Looks like a new one just came out. Do you want it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though, rather than just new ones,
it'd be more accurate to say I want to welcome any of them home.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, I have long wondered whether another
world might harbor a diminutive race akin to that.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: So, I figured I would use this time to rehearse socializing with dolls!
choice_data_list: I see. In that case, I'll go get it!
Is that so? Then I'll go grab it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Are you sure?
In that case, I shall offer
a prayer of blessing right here.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This too is a duty of the Saint...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah, may light shine upon the hero who braves the ordeal!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
